text: General Motors raised multiple 2026 operating guidance measures while lowering net income guidance. North American operations remained the primary earnings source. The company reported reduced warranty costs, narrowing EV losses, continued EV-related cash charges, and substantially completed its announced EV pullback.

meta.note: Financial guidance changes and reported operating results coexist without resolving long-term capital allocation outcomes.

text: Novo Nordisk filed suit against Eli Lilly alleging misleading comparative advertising for GLP-1 medicines and requested injunctive relief and damages. The claims reference differing clinical evidence and advertising content. The disputed advertising remained subject to judicial review at the time of filing.

meta.note: The filing asserts claims without adjudicatig the accuracy of either company's advertising.
